message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large grey serif letters at the top. Below, the bold words "REFORMASI DIKORUPSI" appear in grey, partially obscured by orange graffiti-style letters spelling "PSI" with dripping paint. 

Three male figures are viewed from behind. The central figure, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, raises his right hand to spray orange paint onto the wall with a can. To his left is a figure in a dark red jacket, and to his right is a figure in a tan jacket wearing glasses. All three figures have stylized, elongated features and smooth skin textures. 

The background is a textured grey wall. A red horizontal bar sits at the top right. Small blocks of black text are located at the upper right, center left, and bottom left. The center-left text reads: "CITA-CITA REFORMASI 1998 BERBALIK ARAH DI TANGAN AKTIVIS, PARTAI POLITIK SEPERTI PARTAI SOLIDARITAS INDONESIA, DAN JOKOWI. SELAMAT DATANG OTORITARIANISME ELEKTORAL. H.34". The bottom left includes a barcode, QR code, and pricing information.
